title: Analytics, Metrics and Institutional Intelligence
canonical_ownership: event schema registry and privacy-safe ingestion governance
semantic metric catalog and aggregate snapshots
analytics access projects, exports, lineage, quality and audit evidence
non_goals: raw clinical, private-message, identity-evidence or payment-secret storage
automatic clinical, financial, moderation or editorial decisions
implemented_foundation: immutable event schema and metric registries
governed lifecycle transitions with separation of duties and row versions
signed replay-resistant event ingestion and redacted quarantine
allowlist-first privacy gateway, pseudonymization and sensitive-value rejection
version-pinned aggregate metric query with cohort suppression
